events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: A Matter of Honor

options.text: Honor demands I meet you in the field. I'll see you put in the ground, [character]!
I see you take me for a fool, [character]! I won't throw away my life this way.

events.text: Your brave and ruthless warriors have pillaged the lands outside of [city]! The [rival] are infuriated by this affront. [character] considers such behavior to be beneath contempt. He demands satisfaction! You receive his envoys bearing the message: "You may find it easy, sending your minions in to burn my people out of their homes, but do you have the courage to face me in single combat?" Will you accept this challenge?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Looters

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: We can't allow a precedent like this to be set. Execute these swine.
I'll let it slide this time...

events.text: Your brave warriors have pillaged and plundered the lands outside of [city]. As per their orders, most of your plundering warriors bring any valuable loot back to their officers to be distributed among the men, or sent home to the royal coffers. However, a few soldiers of the [family] Family from a [unit] Unit in the most recent raids were caught attempting to hoard treasures for themselves. Normally, this is considered an act of theft against the crown, and is punished with death, though carrying out such a penalty will anger the [family]. Will you turn a blind eye to this behavior?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Pillage and Plunder

options.text: We need this coin for the royal coffers! Wars aren't cheap.
Distribute this wealth among the leading Family. They've earned it!

events.text: Your brave warriors have pillaged and plundered the lands outside of [city]! The [rival] are infuriated by this affront, but what can they do? While ransacking the area, some of your men unearthed a great treasure trove beneath the rubble. Such wealth could greatly aid the war effort, but your leading Family have suffered and sacrificed so much for the cause, and they too would like to see some compensation for their efforts.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Spoils of [city]

options.text: Distribute the spoils to the troops. Give word that tonight, we celebrate.
A war is not won by squandering resources.

events.text: [rival] lands have proved rich indeed. Another hoard of valuables uncovered in your lightning march forward presents the choice of generosity and excess, or prudence.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [character] Gambit

options.text: This victory - for all [rival] - is a testament to our indomitable spirit.

events.text: In a confluence of the gods' own luck and pure initiative, [character] raiding party stumbles on a band of fleeing [rival] nobility, including the son of [city]'s garrison commander. In a round of lightning negotiations, [character] arranges the son's release in exchange for opening the gates of [city] to [rival] outriders, securing the walls and the city itself with barely a drop of blood spilled.
